purpose: CA-113/114 event-state reconstruction contract. Define when an official event ledger may reconstruct an exact daily listed-common-share state without pretending it is a daily snapshot, and keep payment certificates/private-placement instruments separate.

conditions: A verified baseline state exists before the bounded window.
The official event ledger is proven complete for every listed-share-changing event family relevant to the symbol/window.
Each event carries an independently verified effectiveFromSession; announcement/filing time is retained as knownAt.
Cancellations/revisions preserve versions and cannot rewrite earlier replay states before knownAt.
Verified symbol suspensions are handled before expected-session completeness accounting.
Instrument classes are reconstructed independently; no automatic summation across common shares, payment certificates, private-placement or restricted shares.

facts: Official listing-stage disclosure supports 58,946,031 original listed common shares excluding 25,000,000 private-placement common shares before the payment-certificate stage.
10,000,000 payment certificates become tradable from 2025-11-17 as a distinct instrument stage.

MI_QFIIS reports 93,946,031 from 2025-11-12, before payment-certificate trading and before 2026-01-06 registration approval; therefore that field cannot be substituted for registered-issued or listed-common truth.

positiveControl: If a bounded window has a known baseline plus a complete official event ledger with effective dates and no unresolved revision/instrument conflicts, event-sourced daily state is admissible for that exact semantic space.
negativeControls: A daily field with the same Chinese/English name is not semantic equivalence across reporting systems.
A listing announcement plus one observed daily snapshot is not enough to prove full-window completeness.
A payment certificate must not be silently folded into listed common shares merely because rights are economically similar.
Ex-post historical query availability does not prove first-known timing.
ca113Impact: The strongest blocker is now archive/completeness provenance, not the arithmetic of denominator states.
ca114Impact: 2465 instrument-stage semantics are sufficiently frozen for replay tests; exact daily BFT51U/listed-share archive remains a reconciliation gate, not a semantic-definition gate.
ca115Gate: DO_NOT_REEVALUATE until bounded TWSE/TPEx completeness receipts and revision/knownAt coverage are sufficient.
